description: Figure 7 is a bar chart that illustrates the number of questions out of 40 where Chain of Thought (CoT) generated by GPT-3 using different methods has at least one factual error. The x-axis represents different methods, including base (0.2B), large (0.7B), XL (3B), XXL (11B), and GPT-3 code-davinci-002 (175B). The y-axis is a categorical scale with three levels: OneR, NoR, and IRCoT. The bars are color-coded to represent each method, with OneR in red, NoR in blue, and IRCoT in yellow. The chart shows that IRCoT has the least number of factual errors, followed by OneR, and then NoR, which has the most errors. The values for each method are as follows: base (0.2B) has 1 error, large (0.7B) has 2 errors, XL (3B) has 3 errors, XXL (11B) has 4 errors, and GPT-3 code-davinci-002 (175B) has 5 errors. The chart indicates that as the model size increases, the number of factual errors also increases.
